##### Project general facts

Emaar Vida Residences is a premium branded residential development by Emaar Properties. As the first Vida-branded residences in this master community, the project introduces a refined lifestyle concept that blends contemporary urban living with resort-inspired comfort. Positioned within one of Dubai’s most prestigious green communities, it offers an exclusive residential address overlooking the 18-hole championship golf course.

The development is designed around a curated lifestyle experience, featuring a wide range of premium amenities and services tailored to modern living. Residents enjoy access to landscaped open spaces, leisure zones, and high-end recreational facilities that encourage relaxation, wellness, and social interaction. The overall concept focuses on creating a seamless balance between sophistication, comfort, and community living.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, delivering a clean and elegant aesthetic throughout the residences. Open layouts and large windows enhance natural light and provide scenic views of the surrounding greenery and golf course. The kitchens are equipped with appliances, while the apartments are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills Estate is a one-of-a-kind location. This masterfully designed mixed-use development is an integral part of Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Strategically located between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina, flanked by Al Khail Road, the community provides easy access to the city's most popular districts and attractions.  

Here, all the attractions and benefits of living in the city centre are just around the corner, including world-class healthcare and educational facilities, a central park, a championship golf course, and Dubai Hills Mall, one of Dubai’s most comprehensive lifestyle and shopping destination.

Luxury is about being in the heart of the city and yet away from the hustle and bustle of downtown living. With easy access to Umm Suqeim Road and Al Khail Road, Dubai Hills Estate is just minutes away from Downtown Dubai and other business, retail and tourism hubs. Close proximity to planned Etihad Rail and Dubai Metro lines will allow for fast and easy access to airports and other emirates in the near future.
